mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 30% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (housing starts above 1.2 million units), strong demand signals trigger inflation fears and policy tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% signals economic weakness that triggers policy responses and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in retail sales and housing starts signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of RSAFS increase and HOUST increase fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 30% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions, triggering recession fears that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5%), the S&P 500 underperforms due to aggressive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
